g.text: NOT FOR FABRICATION OR VEHICLE CONNECTION

g.desc: NOT FOR FABRICATION OR VEHICLE CONNECTION

g.text: Two protected low-side devices switch external relay coils; common ON/OFF enable. Do not use heater PWM.

g.desc: Two protected low-side devices switch external relay coils; common ON/OFF enable. Do not use heater PWM.

g.text: External relay contacts switch supplied fused +12 V to each matched wideband controller.

g.desc: External relay contacts switch supplied fused +12 V to each matched wideband controller.

g.text: Controller ground remains connected; 0-5 V outputs feed WB1_0_5V / WB2_0_5V.

g.desc: Controller ground remains connected; 0-5 V outputs feed WB1_0_5V / WB2_0_5V.

g.text: Use coil suppression (diode cathode to coil +12 V, anode to the low-side return) and ON/OFF firmware control.

g.desc: Use coil suppression (diode cathode to coil +12 V, anode to the low-side return) and ON/OFF firmware control.

g.text: The wideband controller, not this relay stage, regulates the LSU heater.
